description: Input data for interviewPrompts evaluation. All fields are optional — partial inputs trigger partial evaluation.

monthlyIncome.description: Total monthly gross income reported by the household.

monthlyExpenses.description: Total monthly expenses reported by the household.

items.description: A person in the household, as the interview rules read them. Shared so a ruleset can reference it rather than restating the shape — the compiler follows the $ref down to individual field paths, which is what keeps missing-input tracking per-field rather than per-object.

isEmployed.description: Whether the member is currently employed.

isStudent.description: Whether the member is enrolled at least half-time in higher education.

isNonCitizen.description: Whether the member is a non-citizen subject to immigration screening.

application.description: Application-level context relevant to the interview.

hasChangedCircumstances.description: Whether the household reported changes since the application was submitted.
